name: evaluate-review-skills
description: Discover in-tree SKILL.md files across the Fuchsia checkout (including any vendor/* sub-repositories when present), evaluate unregistered skills in parallel for suitability in local /review (AGENTIC_REVIEW) and Gerrit CRACS (agent_configs.textproto), and cross-check recommendations.

workspace_root.description: Optional Fuchsia checkout root directory (defaults to current workspace directory).

repo.description: Repository to scan: 'all' (fuchsia.git plus any present vendor/* git repos, default), 'fuchsia', or a relative sub-repo path such as 'vendor/google'.

path_prefix.description: Optional repo-relative path prefix to restrict skill discovery (e.g. 'src/storage' or 'build').

only_unregistered.description: If true (default), only evaluate skills not yet referenced in any existing AGENTIC_REVIEW or agent_configs.textproto.

since_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for measuring git commit volume in target directories (defaults to the past 2 months, i.e., 2026-08-26).

min_commits.description: Minimum commit count since since_date required in target files/directories to recommend AGENTIC_REVIEW.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel skill evaluator agents to run concurrently.

report_path.description: Optional absolute path to write the Markdown evaluation report.
